name: Vocodia Holdings Corp.
summary: Vocodia Holdings Corp. specializes in crafting advanced conversational artificial intelligence platforms designed for sales and customer engagement. Its flagship offering, DISA, is a sophisticated human-like AI technology capable of managing every step of the dialogue-based sales journey, serving both corporate clients (B2B) and individual customers (B2C). Beyond its core AI solutions, the firm also delivers information technology services. Established in 2020, the company operates out of Boca Raton, Florida.
